messages.subject: 有些中文字無法顯示於R
messages.subject_clean: 有些中文字無法顯示於R
messages.body_plain:
這個問題困擾我許久。
當我在R讀入中文資料，無論是使用read.csv, read.table, scan，
有些罕用的中文字會被R自動顯示成UTF-8編碼，例如：
"蒾" -> \\u84be
"椬" -> \\u692c

我在使用以上指令時，也有試著將encoding參數設定成"UTF-8", "ASCII"等等，
或是讀取之後再用iconv來轉編碼，但是都行不通。
想請教大家這個問題如何解決?
謝謝。

messages.subject: Re: How to append data into csv file in R?
messages.subject_clean: How to append data into csv file in R?
messages.body_plain:
Hi friend,

Please refer to the online document for the write.csv command. In the CSV files section: "These wrappers are deliberately inflexible: they are designed to ensure that the correct conventions are used to write a valid file. Attempts to change append, col.names, sep, dec or qmethod are ignored, with a warning."

Please use write.table( ) command.

R code:
###
# title: read table from csv file
# date: 2014.4.4

AA <- read.csv(file="PerRange.csv", sep=",")
AA

# write.csv(AA[1:3,], file="PerRange.csv", col.names=F, append=T)
write.table(AA[1:3,], file="PerRange.csv", append=T, row.names=F, col.names=F,  sep=",")
AA.new <- read.csv(file="PerRange.csv", sep=",")
AA.new
# end
###

> dat
[1] "﻿id,value"          "1,蒾"             "2,璊"             "3,中文字無法顯示"
> dat2 <- matrix(unlist(strsplit(dat, ",")), nrow=length(dat), byrow=TRUE)

Hi,

Are they different between "class", "typeof" and "mode" in R? I found they are a little bit difference, but don't know  what differences in them? (Please refer to below cases)

Does anyone know the answer?

CASE 1:
> x <- 1:3
> x
[1] 1 2 3
> class(x)
[1] "integer"
> typeof(x)
[1] "integer"
> mode(x)
[1] "numeric"

CASE 2:
> class(iris)
[1] "data.frame"
> typeof(iris)
[1] "list"
> mode(iris)
[1] "list"
>
